description: Looker connector. Indexes Looker dashboards and LookML views as `looker:dashboard` and `looker:data_model` items in the local index and exposes read tools (`looker_list`, `looker_get`, `looker_search`) plus HITL-gated write tools (`looker_datagroup_trigger`, `looker_schedule_run_once`). Uses the Looker API 4.0 with OAuth2 client-credentials auth (POST /api/4.0/login). The per-tenant base URL is supplied via the `looker.base_url` vault key and its hostname is added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddLookerMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. LookML view sql_table_name fields are normalized via normalizeDataModelKey to produce cross-connector lineage edges (Looker→dbt).
